job: Move between the product's sections from a list on the left.
purpose: The left column of the app shell: brand and a collapse button on top, a scrolling nav in the middle, and a foot with a usage card and the account row. One nav row is 36px; the current page gets an accent wash. Groups expand in place. Collapsed, it is a 64px rail and labels move into tooltips.
useWhen: The app has more than three destinations people move between all day.
The foot should answer "how much do I have left" and offer the one upsell.

avoidWhen.when: Moving between views of one page.
A section's own links inside the page.
